senses.gloss:
शोषः [शुष्-घञ्]
1 Drying up,
dryness; ह्रदशोषविक्लवां Ku. 4. 39;
so आस्यशोषः, कंठशोषः &c.
--2
Emaciation, withering up; शरीरशोषः,
कुसुमशोषः &c.
--3 Pulmonary
consumption or consumption in general;
संशोषणाद्रसादीनां शोष इत्यभिधीयते Suśr.
--Comp.
--संभवं the root of long
pepper.

शोषण a. (णी f.) [शुष्-ल्यु ल्युट् वा]
1 Drying up, desiccating.
--2
Causing to wither up, emaciating;
Ś. 3. 10.
--णः N. of one of the
arrows of Cupid.
--णं
1 Drying up,
desiccation.
--2 Suction, sucking
up, absorption.
--3 Exhaustion.
--4
Emaciation, withering up.
--5 Dry
ginger.

शोषित p. p.
1 Dried up;
शोषितसरसि निदाघे नितरामेवोद्धतः सिंधुः
Subhāṣ.
--2 Emaciated, withered up.
--3 Exhausted.

शोषिन् a. (णी f.) Drying up,
withering, emaciating; हुदयकुसुमशोषी
[]
दारुणो दीर्घशोकः U. 3. 5.

सोष्मन् a.
1 Warm, hot.
--2 (In
gram.) Aspirated. --m. An aspirate.
